FIPS 204 specifies ML-DSA, a digital-signature algorithm
FIPS 205 specifies SLH-DSA, a digital-signature algorithm
The memo’s all-encryption and differing-day claims are false
latent: Distinguish key establishment from data encryption
Distinguish final standards from earlier drafts or later errata
Explain why signatures and KEMs solve different needs
clarify: Which cryptographic functions need replacement
Whether the user needs standards or implementation guidance

required: Pull-request head code is untrusted
pull_request_target has base-repository privileges and can access secrets

Use unprivileged pull_request testing without secrets
Keep publishing in a separate trusted workflow and minimize token permissions
latent: A base-branch-only labeling workflow can use pull_request_target without executing fork code
Artifact handoff also requires validation
Fork approval and read-only defaults are safeguards, not an excuse to mix privileges

latent: State WMO uncertainty around annual estimate

Avoid asserting the target remains guaranteed reachable
clarify: Which exact Paris metric is intended

Which decision the statement informs
